title: Missing packet ID in `finalizeOpen()` causes NFT loss
summary: _Resolved_  ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  In the `Packet.sol` contract, the `finalizeOpen()` function has a critical flaw that will cause all transactions to fail when the `burnType` is **INSTANT_OPEN_PACKET**. When processing an **INSTANT_OPEN_PACKET** burn type, the function attempts to add the packet to inventory by calling `packetStore.addPacketsToInventory(packetIds)`.
